next.notifyBots.title: Telegram
next.notifyBots.foot: An agent writes through a bot when its instruction says so. Tokens stay on this machine and are never sent back here.
next.notifyBots.empty: Link a bot and an agent will message you on Telegram when it finishes a long task or needs your answer.
next.notifyBots.add.hintAfter: using /newbot and paste the token it sends you.
next.notifyBots.token.label: Token
next.notifyBots.name: Name
next.notifyBots.instruction.placeholder: Write here when you finish a long task or need my answer
next.notifyBots.instruction.hint: The agent sees the name and this instruction and uses the bot only as it says.
next.notifyBots.chat.label: Chat
next.notifyBots.bind.open: Open the bot and press Start
next.notifyBots.bind.group: For a group: add the bot to it and send
next.notifyBots.bind.waiting: Waiting for a message to the bot…
next.notifyBots.reason.bad-token: That does not look like a bot token: it reads like 123456789:AA…
next.notifyBots.reason.invalid-token: Telegram did not accept the token. Check it with @BotFather
next.notifyBots.reason.not-found: This bot is gone — reload the page
next.notifyBots.reason.webhook: The bot has a webhook, so a chat cannot be bound. Remove the webhook (deleteWebhook) or create a separate bot
next.notifyBots.reason.chat-gone: The bot cannot write to the chat: it was removed from the group or blocked. Bind the chat again
next.notifyBots.reason.rate-limited: Too many messages, wait a minute
next.notifyBots.reason.unreachable: Telegram did not answer the machine. Try again
next.notifyBots.reason.bad-name: The name cannot be empty or longer than 64 characters
next.notifyBots.reason.bad-instruction: The instruction is longer than 2000 characters
next.notifyBots.reason.expired: The code expired: nobody pressed Start within 10 minutes. Bind the chat again
next.notifyBots.reason.failed: The machine could not save the bots
next.notifyBots.reason.no-shared: There is no shared bot here
next.notifyBots.reason.offline: The platform did not answer — showing what was seen last. Try again
next.notifyBots.reason.disabled: Your own bots are switched off: notifications go through the shared bot
next.notifyShared.foot: The harnessly bot writes. Disconnect here or with /stop in the bot.
next.notifyShared.none: An agent will message you on Telegram when a long task is done or it needs your answer.
next.notifyShared.waiting: Press Start in the chat with the bot that opened…
next.notifyShared.instruction.hint: Agents on all your machines see this instruction and write only as it says.
